description:
Meet Boss Crowns, an Authorized Belle Tress Dealer where confidence comes pre‑styled. We hand‑select premium, salon‑grade synthetic units and ship them ready‑to‑slay in today’s most requested cuts and color blends. Our edge? Consistent, influencer‑approved looks that buyers rave about—and that you can’t find at big‑box beauty stores. 

Affiliates pocket a solid 10% commission, paid via PayPal on the 1st of each month, with a 30‑day cookie window. You’ll get insider training, and early access to new drops. Join us and help your followers crown their best selves—hair flip optional but encouraged!

1. Boss Crowns “Top Boss” Affiliate Program

Terms & Conditions

IMPORTANT NOTE — These T&C create a binding contract between you (“Affiliate”) and Anderehr Inc. d/b/a Boss Crowns (“Company,” “we,” “our,” “us”). By applying for, or participating in, the Program you agree to all terms below. If you disagree, do not join or use your unique link/code. Nothing here is legal advice; consult your own counsel.

1. Definitions

  • Program – The Boss Crowns “Top Boss” Affiliate Program.

  • Affiliate Link / Code – Your unique URL or discount code provided by us for tracking sales.

  • Net Sales – Gross revenue from eligible wig orders excluding taxes, shipping, returns, chargebacks, and discounts (including your 25 % affiliate discount).

  • Commission – Ten percent (10 %) of Net Sales generated via your Link/Code and approved under §5.

2. Eligibility & Enrollment

2.1 Must be 18 and reside in the United States.
2.2 Submit a complete application and executed Form W‑9. We may accept or reject any applicant in our sole discretion.
2.3 Affiliates are independent contractors (IRS 1099); no employment, agency, or franchise relationship is created.

3. Your Perks

3.1 Personal Discount – 25 % off wigs you purchase for personal use (non‑transferable).
3.2 Commission – 10 % of Net Sales attributed to your Link/Code and accepted under §5.
3.3 Marketing Assets – We supply logos, images, and approved copy (the “Materials”). Use only as provided.

4. Affiliate Obligations

4.1 FTC Disclosures – You must clearly and conspicuously disclose any “material connection” in all posts (e.g., “I earn a commission on sales through this link—#ad”).
4.2 Brand Integrity – No misleading claims about products, earnings, or Company; no offensive, illegal, or deceptive content.
4.3 Paid Ads – Bidding on “Boss Crowns,” misspellings, or our trademarks is prohibited without written consent.
4.4 Spam – No unsolicited commercial email or SMS.
4.5 Data Privacy – You will not collect personal data from customers except through our provided portals.

5. Commission Tracking & Approval

5.1 Sales are tracked via cookies (30‑day attribution) or code entry at checkout.
5.2 Returned, refunded, or fraudulent orders are deducted.
5.3 We issue a commission report monthly; you have 30 days to dispute discrepancies.
5.4 Commissions become “Approved” 30 days after the order ships (return window closes).

6. Payouts

6.1 Minimum payout threshold: $50. Balances below roll forward.
6.2 Payouts via ACH or PayPal on the 15th of each month for the prior month’s Approved commissions.
6.3 Affiliate is solely responsible for all federal, state, and local taxes.

7. Intellectual Property

All Materials remain our property. Non‑exclusive, revocable license granted for Program promotion only.

8. Prohibited Conduct (Grounds for Immediate Termination)

  • Trademark or copyright infringement.

  • Coupon‑site or discount aggregator postings without permission.

  • Any form of deceptive, abusive, or illegal marketing.

  • Violation of §§4 or 7.

9. Term & Termination

9.1 Effective on our written acceptance of your application and continues until terminated.
9.2 Either party may terminate at any time for any reason with written notice (email suffices).
9.3 Upon termination: (a) all licenses end; (b) you must remove Materials; (c) pending Approved commissions up to termination date will be paid on the next cycle.

10. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Company’s aggregate liability arising out of the Program shall not exceed total commissions paid to Affiliate during the six (6) months preceding the claim.

11. Indemnification

Affiliate agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold Company, its officers, and employees harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from Affiliate’s acts or omissions, including breach of these T&C or violation of applicable laws.

12. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

These T&C are governed by the laws of the State of Texas (without regard to conflict‑of‑laws rules). Any dispute shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Pampa, Texas, and the parties consent to personal jurisdiction therein.

13. Amendments

We may update these T&C at any time by posting the revised version on BossCrowns.me. Continued participation constitutes acceptance.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to hello@bosscrowns.me for support.
